Rabbit Ride

Bellingham, WA · Fairhaven · Road

Rabbit Ride is a road group ride in Bellingham, WA. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Fairhaven Bicycles (rally point only).

Next ride Sun, Oct 4, 8:00 AM PDT
Host's website ↗ Add to calendar Google Calendar Text it · WhatsApp · Email

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed on the host's own page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

Mount Baker Bicycle Club's event calendar lists the Rabbit Ride for Sundays Oct 4, 11, 18 and 25, 2026 at 8:00 AM, and its Weekly Rides page says 8 a.m. during daylight saving time (roughly March through October) and 8:30 a.m. in standard time; the old 7:45 / 8:15 times were on a March 1 entry.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 16+ mph; groups leave by speed, fastest last. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rabbit Ride group ride

A self-organized Sunday road ride down Chuckanut Drive and back by Lake Samish. Groups roll out by pace, slowest first, fastest five minutes later. The shop is just the meeting spot and does not run it. Show up ready to ride at the start time.
